top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, complete discovery chain: the incretin effect and proglucagon processing, the identity and actions of active GLP-1(7-36), and drugs with confirmed glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The citation is scoped to the physiology and active form of the hormone, with the therapies as consequence, and the three names (Holst, Drucker, Mojsov) are separable contributions. Contested priority (Mojsov vs Habener) and the omission of Knudsen are real credit limitations but do not justify withholding the prize, so no award is ranked below it.
